name: Visa Verify
tagline: A checkout widget that scores device, network and behaviour signals to flag card fraud without slowing honest buyers.

awards: Visa Truth and Trust Track Prize

problem: Card fraud costs billions and erodes trust in online payments.
solution: A Chrome extension simulates a merchant checkout widget; a backend combines device, network and behavioural signals into a real-time risk score.
demo_moment: Team-described: a normal purchase passes and a suspicious one is flagged.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Visa Truth and Trust Track Prize” among 160 submissions.
Keeps friction low for legitimate users.

lessons: Fraud demos need two paths: the honest one must stay smooth.
